mentions.name: Scrawl
mentions.description: This app is a minimal handwritten note-taking app for the iPad with optional built-in AI querying that accepts handwritten and spoken input instead of typed text. It is designed to be free, local, and simple, keeping optional AI features out of the user's way unless needed. Version 1 launched on the App Store about a week prior, with roughly 130 downloads and 2 users paying for the AI tier.
mentions.problem: Existing iPad note-taking apps like Notability and GoodNotes have become overly bloated, lacking a free, local, and simple option.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://tryscrawl.com - minimal handwritten note-taking app for the iPad with optional, built-in AI querying (using handwritten/spoken interfaces instead of typed text).
